images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Front view inside a small neon-lit coin laundromat at night, teal tiled walls and a checkered floor with pink neon reflections. Center: an enormous mint-enamel drum washing machine with a chrome porthole; behind the glass a giant pink knitted scarf tumbles in blue water and white foam, with a glowing orange lava stain and a green slime stain. Behind the washer, a rain-streaked shop window shows a huge dark lava-giant monster with glowing orange cracks resting its chin on its hand, one sleepy amber eye watching, and smaller monster silhouettes queuing on a purple night street. Right: a cream paper order ticket pinned with a pink pin and a dark recipe notebook listing stain-to-detergent combos. Bottom control bar: three detergent bottles (cyan, green, violet), a chrome temperature dial, speed buttons, result meters and a big glowing pink start button. Korean UI: title '괴수 세탁소', '세탁 시작', '수축 위험 12%'. Stylized 2D illustration, hot pink and cyan neon, deep indigo, soap bubbles floating, soft glow.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same laundromat in emergency: everything bathed in pulsing red alarm light, a red rotating beacon on the wall. The giant washer's door hangs open and inside dangles a tiny shrunken pink knitted scarf on a yellow clothes peg, with a white tag reading '수축 −68%' and '14m → 4.5m'; foam spills across the floor. Through the cracked shop window two enormous furious amber monster eyes with slit pupils press against the glass on either side of the washer, lava veins glowing, spider-web cracks in the pane. Big glowing red text on the left: '부글이 폭주!'. Right: a dark red claim panel with a striped rage bar at 100, a results list with green checks for stains and red crosses for length, a cause note, three choice buttons with the gold top one reading '다리미로 늘려 보기', and a white speech bubble from the monster. Stylized 2D illustration, crimson and magenta, neon glow, soap bubbles, slight camera shake feel.
